title: Dukok
description: This mod adds the popular internet meme dukok and his dimension and some other stuff.
body:
Hi my name is Smajlik_sk and this is my first mod.

I was developing the first version 2 days i was using mcreator and blockbench.
I am not a good 3d modeler or an artist.

This mod adds dukok his dimension 2 achivment drink liquid and a sword.
This mod was base of a pupular slovak and czech meme dukok.
I was based of a popular youtuber ducklok the meme is him but with one eye.
There is a hole creepy pasta about dukok he is calling in the middle of the night.
